Being a sports junkie, I  tend to compare and contrast life events with sports providing interesting reflections.
The battle between Covid on one side, and human with science as an ally on the other hand, feels like a long drawn tennis match. Covid always seems to draw first blood, however human/science partnership rallies from behind to tie the match.

With Omicron, Covid went ahead break point, however human/science partnership has recognised newer patterns adopted by the opposition, and working towards "deuce".
That's resilience at its best.

Have a wonderful resilient week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

A very morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The start of the past week was tragic with us losing 12 members of our Armed Forces family including General Rawat. The Armed Forces is our family that protects our country and us unconditionally. Salute to the entire Indian Armed Forces 🙌🙌🙌 and tribute to the 12 members 🙏🙏.

Am taking the liberty of sharing an experience from the week that many of you may find relatable  that can possibly bring back some smiles :
After a period 21 months, I facilitated a workshop in person. It felt like I had just landed in the "real universe" from an "alternate universe" and it was truly an experience of unbridled joy. Having said that, the virtual universe provides so much flexibility, especially from a logistics perspective.
No wonder, we seem to be moving towards a hybrid universe - to get our fair share of joyful experience and flexible logistics.

Have a wonderful week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.
Very *Good* morning 😊

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The general buzz over the past 2-3 weeks has been around the appointment of two Indian-origin CEOs for global organizations - Parag Agrawal for Twitter and Leena Nair for Chanel.

But beyond their Indian origins and other firsts, I thought there were  interesting inferences.

Twitter is truly a Tech Platform company at its core and promoted their CTO to the role of CEO (somewhat rare in business circles) - perhaps an indication of the value of Tech and therefore someone best positioned to capitalise the power of Tech and monetize the same.

On the other side was Chanel, a company with rich legacy in fashion and truly dependent on people - _employees_ to take pride in building differentiated experience and building advocates of their _customers_ . Maybe that led to one of the best global CHROs to be anointed as the CEO (again somewhat rare).

It perhaps speaks to the clarity of *purpose* of these organizations and picking up the person most aligned to the same thru expertise, experience and culture.

Have a great purposeful week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

As we get to the last week of 2021 and get set to bid goodbye to the year, I cannot help but salute 2021 for the year that was 🙌🙌.
We had so much hope as we eagerly awaited the advent of 2021 - a hope perhaps emanating from some facts and more of wishful thinking. It was almost like a new CEO handed over the reigns of an organization in deep trouble. For all the turbulence that 2021 faced in the journey, it turned around the performance of the massive behemoth called life delivering on the hope for a very large part. All of us are starting to lead a "new" normal life - many traveling to meet their long distant families, celebrating occasions that were put in back burner and moving ahead with other pursuits.
Thank you 2021 for being a true ally 🤗.

As we await the dawn of 2022, let us welcome the New Year with a renewed hope and pray that the headwinds that keep coming up are alleviated - and that 2022 truly builds on the performance of 2021.

Wish you all a blissful and blessed 2022 🎉🎊🎈☀️🙏

Very good morning and a very Happy New Year.
Hope you all had a good week, welcoming 2022.

I realized that any new beginning holds mixed feelings - "excitement & hope" around how we could shape the new, and perhaps in equal measure  "uncertainty" of what the new holds for us.

The advent of the New Year  seems no different to me. I am excited about 2022, with the prospect of meeting more friends and family in person, amongst other things, in the midst of  the lingering uncertainty.

May your excitement and hopes for 2022 turn out to be true.
Have a wonderful start to 2022 ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week - the full first week of 2022.

Deja Vu - that's what I felt, as we are going thru curfews and switching back to everything online. However, the situation seems definitely different from 2020, when we had no clue about this monster, to 2021 where the second wave brought in a "sinking" feeling. In 2022, the experts seem to provide a lot more positive and definitive view, with even a potential timeframe for this to peak and then retract. Perhaps, it's Nature's way to remind us mildly to keep our part of the bargain - to continue to demonstrate the desirable behaviors.

Have a positive week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The past week as it seamlessly moves into this week, for me, has been about Virat Kohli stepping down as the leader of the current Indian cricket team. Love him or hate him, you cannot ignore his intensity and impact. In the contemporary world of cricket, he, perhaps , had  a larger than life image and that was the authentic Kohli - he truly did not worry if everyone loved him for how he operated. Yet there came a time when a mix of circumstances led him to relinquish his overall leadership position.

No different than what happens in the area of business. Leaders come, create impact in their own authentic styles - some loved and some not. Then comes a point to fade away - some do it gracefully, while others do not, and yet there is an inevitability. What  remains is "the legacy the leader has left behind".

Have you all thought about the legacy you are leaving behind ?

Have a great impactful week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The Indian cricket team that could do no wrong seems to have moved to the other end of the pendulum where they could do no right. Am sure there are enough daggers pointing at the leader - captain and coach.

No different in our business lives - some of you may have driven and faced the  challenges in transitions. If you do well, you have "just continued" the good work; if you faltered, there are potential knives and daggers hovering. My sense of what has helped get thru these initial dark days into the sunny days is the leader's resilience, conviction and persistence.

What has helped you ?

Have a sunny week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

My weekend was made absolutely fascinating by Rafael Nadal. 2 sets down in the Grandslam final which has always been his nemesis (lost 4 finals and had won just 1 prior to this), against a player who is seeded higher at #2 and a decade younger, he turned the heat on and won his second Australian Grandslam - and inched forward to his 21st title , ahead of his illustrious compatriots Federer and  Djokovic.

There were many emotions and attributes at play - resilience perhaps trumping all other attributes. That's what makes sports special for me 🙌🙌🙌

The first post I saw congratulating Rafa, in the most gracious manner was Mr. Grace personified and a fierce competitor Roger Federer.  Only in sports do you see competitors celebrating success of others - another reason I Iove sports 🙌🙌🙌.

Have a wonderful week ahead - celebrate your journey as well as success of others ⛅☀️🙏.

@⁨Sanjay Gupta⁩ - interesting perspective.
Individual resilience seem to trump everything else - in that sense, perhaps tennis is unique .

Very good morning. Hope all of you had a good week.

As we all know, God decided to "retire" the voice of our nation  yesterday.

Over the 9 decades that she lived and blessed us all with her inimitable voice, Lata Mangeshkar-ji had sung over 25000 songs in multiple languages, while being "melody personified", inspiring multiple generations of singers, actresses for whom she sang, and left an impact on every citizen of India.
Her live voice has been retired, but her voice will continue to remain amidst us.

May her life inspire us to be the best we can be in our chosen field while staying humble 🙏🙏.

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope all of you had a good week.

For me, the weekend was all about the much-anticipated IPL auction. It was about what actually transpired - who got what; even more interesting was what the individual player may have anticipated and what they finally "priced" for.

Someone, who just 3 years back was in the "too hot 🔥 - handle with care" was in the "too cold - anyone interested ?" category this year.

Sports is a great leveler and keeps everyone grounded, from time to time.

Wish we had a similar mechanism in the corporate - where different teams, divisions, perhaps organizations transparently call out the  "true worth" of the individual at the current juncture to them. Maybe this can deflate our sense of self importance and focus on contribution than "perceived value".

Have a reflective week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

A very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The week, for me, had some sports action and even more entertainingly political action connected to elections across multiple states.

There is a lot to learn from politicians around "speed",  "agility" and "presence" - regardless of their ideology. They rake up issues seemingly out of thin air, and we get to experience a war of allegations and counter-allegations.

Before we, the citizens can comprehend the issue at hand, they have already moved to the next one.

We do not need to subscribe to their means, but perhaps learn to act with speed, agility and presence.

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The week, for me, has been about Russia-Ukraine crisis with a sombre reminder that geo political peace cannot be taken for granted - all it requires is  one spark and eruption and we are all vulnerable and almost helpless.

Do hope that the Russian-Ukranian sides find sanity and some middle ground to resolve the current crisis.

This seems to be true in our lives as well - peace of mind and healthy relationships cannot be taken for granted  - we need to invest in these on an ongoing basis to nurture these.

Have a great week filled with investments in relationships ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

Amongst all the exciting sports action during the week, we lost a true sports icon - Shane Warne.

He truly was once a generation player and entertainer. His instrument was the "ball" - it was as if he was a magician and the ball listened to him with scant regard for the batters, regardless of their pedigree 🙌🙌🙌.

He was the source of inspiration for many leg spinners to select this art -  some of them creating an impact themselves.

In some sense he may have inspired each one of us, to be the best we can, in the field that we have chosen,  and leave a legacy.

Have a wonderful week ahead as you all build your own legacy ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you a had a good week.

For me, the highlight of the week was the election results for the 5 states. The anticipation is very similar to that of Olympics in some sense - it's about who strikes "Gold".

It starts with Opinion polls prior to start of the election on  "who could win" - and many of these distinct polls are like chalk and cheese with limited convergence.

Then comes the Exit polls after the election by "pundits" and "pollsters". Any correlation of these polls to "Real Results" based on real citizen voting is purely coincidental - yet it's fun to listen to all the forecasting.

Amidst all this, a real election is conducted across 5 states spanning the West to the North East and North covering a population of around 250 million for around 700 seats with 5 times the number of candidates - that indeed is the power of democracy.

Mera Bharat Mahaan 🙏

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏
Congratulations @⁨Nivarthi⁩ on the launch of your second book 👏👏

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

I had a delightful weekend, having had the opportunity to meet 2 people after almost a decade - one from out of the country who had flown in, and one who out resides in a different city. It was so energizing meeting them after a very long time, pronounced even more by our inability to meet real people in person in the real world over the past 2 years.

I hope you are all able to  meet real people in the real world -  people who make a difference for you -  and get your mojo up.

Have a great energetic week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope all of you had a good week.

As always, I find inspiring leadership moments in sports, and the past week was no different for me.

The first moment was when Ash Barty, the current World #1 in Women's tennis and on a winning momentum announced her retirement from tennis. To step down in any area, when you are at the pinnacle, while continuing to move North, requires courage and conviction, and she was the epitome of that. She looked very secure and comfortable with her decision.

The second moment was when MS Dhoni - the Captain extraordinaire and the soul of CSK passed on the baton to his hand-picked successor, while still being present to mentor the successor. To me, this was about the commitment not to just pick a successor, but enable the successor for success.

Some interesting "points to ponder" for all of us.

Have a great week with your own Leadership moments ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a great week.

Time flies. We are already into the second quarter of the calendar year and into Q1 of the new financial year.

Co-incidentally, many organizations have requested their employees to show up physically 2-3 days in a week. Surely, many would be looking forward to this, as they get to meet their teams and peers in person, building better camaraderie and collaboration. Equally, there would be many that would find this "new" official need tedious and challenging - some having to relocate back from their home towns to the office-city, while others having to commute across the city to get to their offices.

I do hope that the organizations somehow establish the magic balance of a hybrid working model - motivating the entire work force.

Hope all of you get to establish your individual state of equilibrium.

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

So am back to sports again. After the past week, the two best teams with an enviable pedigree of having won 9 of 14 IPL titles between them, are languishing as the bottom two teams this season, with an unenviable position of 4 for 4 losses each - the only two teams with that predicament.

Would be interesting to know the captain's and the coach's state of mind, and their approach to motivate the teams to move forward. Never easy, yet that's what great leaders do - they are immensely resilient.

Curious to know if you have been in a similar predicament , and what did it take to motivate your team  to bounce back, making the journey worthwhile.

Have a wonderful resilient week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

Unity in Diversity - that's India for you. Over the past week, many states in India celebrated and welcomed the New Year. About two weeks back another set of states in India had celebrated the advent of New Year.

Why is this worth highlighting ?
India is perhaps one of the countries with a high level of innate diversity, with 36 distinct territories - states and union territories, with over 100 languages and dialects spoken across.
Construct-wise this may be more similar to the European Union.

And therefore, the commonality we share and how we connect & communicate with one another across the country is just awe-inspiring, and deeply entrenched within the broader populace.

Mera Bharat Mahaan 🙏

Have an awe-inspiring week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

I enjoyed traveling for a family function this weekend and grateful for the opportunity to meet close cousins and other relatives, whom I had not met for a very long time.

I recognise it would be naive to believe that we are past Covid, as it continues to linger around - yet, glad that we are all slowly starting to do things that bring joy to us.

Have a joyous week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

For me, the week was about the tale of batteries. Must have been an auspicious week for my laptop battery and my car battery to malfunction.

In case of the laptop battery, the service provider dispassionately indicated that the battery had to be replaced - I did feel the pinch having to shell out  within a year after it had been replaced, with the warranty having expired.

On the other hand, my car battery still had the warranty, but not as simple as it sounded.
I called up a neighborhood battery specialist.  He was truly responsive and took complete ownership to my pleasant surprise, and arranged to deliver a replacement battery within his service charge - he had to go back and forth and call me to work out logistics multiple times.

Now that was true "customer delight" generated by a human being demonstrating a genuine sense of ownership.

Interesting point to ponder - how do we demonstrate genuine ownership in our roles.

Have a wonderful week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you had a good week.

For me, the past week has all been about India winning the Thomas Cup men's badminton championship and making a grand entry into the elite group of countries that have won the same.  What is more commendable is that the Indian team beat 5 time past winners in the  quarters and 14 time past winners in the finals.


This has not been a flash in the pan. In the past decade, India has graduated to be amongst the premium badminton playing countries with a host of men and women players being in the top 10, winning Olympic medals and other world championship events. It takes an entire ecosystem to create a high-performing culture.

Accomplishments and Outcomes surely bring in recognition - yet it's the seeds that are sowed & nurtured, and a belief that is created that leads to these outcomes. I believe that the journey is so important that can set the tone for outcomes.

Hope you are all continuing your journey to your desired land.

Have a wonderful week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The past week had some sports events that could easily escape our attention and mind share - the Archery World Cup and World Boxing championship. Incidentally India won gold in both these.

The athletes in these sports may not be top of our recall as there is inadequate visibility and sponsorship - yet they have to perform out of their skins to win these events. Am sure the level of preparation and practice is no less than much of the more glamorous sports.

No different than what we see in academic and business situations. Certain streams of education and business roles have more visibility and glamour while some others may not have the same, yet equally important for the  ecosystem. The less visible work as hard and contribute while they may not get the recognition.

An interesting point to ponder - regardless of our role, organization, business, how much pride do we take in what we do.

Have a great week ahead beaming with pride ⛅☀️🙏.

How are you ? Great to hear from you after a long time.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

If you are a sports aficionado/ junkie, you would have loved the week that went by.

Two summit clashes :
-> one where experience trumped expectations - 13 times Champion League Title holder Real Madrid winning their 14th and creating a larger gap with the next nearest title aggregator
-> one where consistent team performance with no "halo effect" trumped brilliant individual star-studded performances - Gujarat Titans winning the IPL title on their debut season while staying "under the radar" for most of the season.

We also had a Formula 1 race where the individual who had to cede victory to his team mate last week per instructions from the "team bosses" won it anyways this week with no one ceding to him.

Interesting and contrasting case studies - the only thing it seems to suggest is to "build your own playbook for success".
Have you already built one for yourself ?

Have a wonderful week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

If you are a hardcore Nadal fan like me, the highlight of the week had to be his 14th French Open and 22nd Grand Slam. In fact, his dominance of  Roland Garros is so unprecedented, that the authorities will have to rename French Open to Rafael Nadal Open - 14 of the 18 titles since 2005.  Two-thirds of his overall Grand Slams is from one surface.

A point to ponder :
As he is starting to get older, he seems to be comfortable on which surfaces to let go and which surface he has a real chance to win.

As we grow in the corporate ladder, do we identify our true strengths and play around it, while letting go of roles that may not  create an impact.

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏
Love your insight - the idea of experience and energy

A very good morning. Hope all had a good week.

I had an interesting experience during the week, spending time @ the hospital - not for myself, and nothing critical. The nurses left an indelible impact through their service orientation. They always had a genuine warmth in their smile, and the way they engaged with the patients and their families. In our industry parlance, they indeed were the front-line workers creating the customer experience - and they did effortlessly with a certain sense of dignity and genuineness.

I felt we could attribute some part of that to very effective training and yet I felt a bigger part of that had to come from within - an innate sense of joy and fulfilment.

Got me thinking of the words we use in business , many times without a blink of an eye - customer centricity, differentiated customer experience & delight, service orientation, etc and yet the journey to building teams that imbibe and internalize that is not very easy.
How do we build a workforce that take pride and demonstrate infectious energy and enthusiasm - a point to ponder.

Have a great week ahead with opportunity to spread infectious enthusiasm around ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

After a very long period - perhaps over 3 years - had an opportunity to watch a movie in the theatre along with my family. The movie was Tom Cruise's "Top Gun - Maverick". The theatre was completely packed.

In fact, the first movie of Tom Cruise that I had watched was Top Gun in 1986, and had become an instant fan for his on-screen intensity, watching many of his subsequent movies.

In an industry where new actors keep coming and quickly get embraced for their style and performance, Tom Cruise has thrived at near 60, with newer generations embracing him as well. A couple of questions that came up my mind were his source of motivation and his willingness to reimagine to stay relevant.

Point to ponder : what are our sources of motivation and how do we work to stay relevant .

Have a great motivated week ahead  ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you a had a good week.

Had a good week.

Was reflecting on the commendable turnaround that the English cricket team has undergone with the anointment of a new leadership team - coach and captain. There weren't too many visible changes made to the overall team composition and yet this team looked so different in its intent and impact in such a short time.

Really curious to know what they did - perhaps freeing the team members of any encumbrance and letting them be their natural selves ?

Point to ponder - have we experienced or enabled such an environment, bringing the best of the team ?

Have a great unencumbered week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

For me, this week was all about meeting ex-colleagues and friends whom I have not had an opportunity to meet for a very long time - 5 years at the least, and more in many cases.

I absolutely enjoyed these treasured moments, getting us to reminisce cherished memories of the past as well.

Life does provide us with these wonderful "unplugged" opportunities, amidst the humdrum of our business-goals-led journey.

Have a wonderful week ahead creating memories to be treasured ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The news of Nadal's withdrawal from the semis of Wimbledon was disappointing for his hard core fans like me, especially after his win in the quarters - an absolute thriller.

He indicated it was not worth pushing his body further with his ailment for now, so that he can hopefully recuperate and prepare his body for a longer stint. It was amazing to see the level of clarity he had around  short-term vs long-term, and specifically how he talked about his health being important than any title.

Point to ponder : do we also assess our life journey balancing health, family and professional successes .

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

Had an opportunity to connect with a couple of  younger professional acquaintances during the weekend. It was absolutely fascinating to hear the journeys they have embarked on - having set up their own operations, moving out of their secure jobs where they were doing very well.

As Simon Sinek would perhaps have commented, they had clarity and conviction of the "Why" of their ventures - everything else seems to flow seamlessly from there.

Point to ponder - do we have the same clarity and conviction on the "Why" of our professional journeys ?

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

For me, the past week was indeed about gratitude - my sincere gratitude to everyone who passed on their wishes to me on my B-day . I am absolutely  enthused and energized - thanks for the same.

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏

Thanks Geetha and Vidya.

Just trying to get even more energy from you all 🙏
Thanks Shubham, Deepak, Sanjay

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

The week that was -  The Chess Olympiad 2022 was inaugurated in India with over 180 countries participating.
The 2022 Commonwealth games started in Birmingham.

Mirabai Chanu won the first gold for India in the Games in weightlifting. She has made it a habit to win gold medals galore, interspersed with rare silver in Olympics and other events. She has been "in the business" and winning since 2014 - winning BIG and yet winning quiet. We hardly see her in the media and yet her "Actions speak so loud" and that too so consistently.

Salute to Mirabai Chanu🫡.

Point to ponder - which is louder for us - actions or words.

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week.

One of the highlights of the past week was the Commonwealth games 2022 in Birmingham.

Sports, especially the individual ones require so much more focus, self belief and most importantly resilience.

The difference between winning and a near-miss in terms of sheer performance may not be high, but the emotional aftermath is the difference between day and night. No scope for complacency after a win, nor a scope for self-pity after a loss - they are already preparing for the next event.

So much for us to learn from the sports persons.

Point to ponder - do we dust ourselves off year after year regardless of how the year went .

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏.

Very good morning. Hope you all had a good week - a short week in India after the Independence day celebrations.

The news that generated interest in me in the prior week was related to Meg Lanning , an accomplished leader having led the Australian cricket team for over 8 years, announcing that she is taking a break with no timelines.

Sportspersons must be experiencing a lot of stress,  subject to  expectations from self and others to produce desirable outcomes consistently. In a team sport, there is always the risk of someone else taking their position. It, then requires courage to take a break with no timelines.

Not very different from corporates where leaders go thru a lot of stress due to expectations from self and others.

Point to ponder : How difficult is it to step aside, take a break or decide to slow down to focus on self and family and perhaps  explore  other interests ?

Have a great week ahead ⛅☀️🙏
